The Draelos Lab volunteered at [BrainsRule!](https://sites.google.com/umich.edu/brainsrule/), an annual outreach event to get middle school students excited about science and the brain. Jake, Nicole, Varnika, and Rachel hosted a booth where they showed the students how we can record EMG signals and observe different patterns from different movements and use them to decode what movement someone is doing. They also had an activity involving a pattern matching card game to show how our brains can learn patterns similarly to computer algorithms.
